message.playermarket.access_revoked: §c[PLAYER MARKET] Market access permanently revoked (Section 17.4). You are no longer the client.
asset.playermarket.max_health.desc: Sell core vital capacity. Reduces player base hearts.
Sacrifice bodily recovery speed and healing potency.
asset.playermarket.saturation.desc: Increases metabolic burnout and exhaustion rates.
asset.playermarket.hunger_efficiency.des: Demands more nutrition to sustain bodily stamina.
asset.playermarket.oxygen_capacity.desc: Reduces submerged lung endurance in water.
asset.playermarket.fire_resistance.desc: Increases burn duration and vulnerability to flames.
asset.playermarket.fall_resistance.desc: Increases impact damage sustained from vertical falls.
asset.playermarket.movement_speed.desc: Decreases ground traversal and walking velocity.
asset.playermarket.sprint_efficiency.des: Causes heavy speed penalty while running at full sprint.
asset.playermarket.swim_speed.desc: Reduces velocity and hydro-mobility in fluids.
asset.playermarket.step_height.desc: Restricts ability to step smoothly over elevation changes.
asset.playermarket.attack_damage.desc: Permanently diminishes kinetic melee strike power.
asset.playermarket.attack_speed.desc: Lengthens weapon recovery and strike cooldown intervals.
asset.playermarket.armor.desc: Compromises internal bone density and baseline armor rating.
asset.playermarket.armor_toughness.desc: Reduces resistance to armor-piercing kinetic strikes.
Amplifies momentum received from hostile weapon impacts.
asset.playermarket.entity_reach.desc: Shortens effective weapon reach in melee combat engagements.
Amplifies blast impulse and explosive vulnerability.
asset.playermarket.knockback_power.desc: Lessens the impulse imparted to enemies upon landing strikes.
asset.playermarket.mining_speed.desc: Slows tool excavation rate against subterranean strata.
asset.playermarket.block_reach.desc: Reduces reach distance for placing and harvesting blocks.
asset.playermarket.luck.desc: Lowers favorable probabilities for dungeon loot and rare fishing yields.
asset.playermarket.submerged_mining.desc: Imposes severe underwater block destruction penalties.
build.playermarket.glass_cannon.title: GLASS CANNON
build.playermarket.glass_cannon.desc: Massive combat output paired with razor-thin vital capacity.
build.playermarket.industrial_worker.des: Extreme excavation velocity, deep subterranean ore scanner telemetry.
build.playermarket.speed_demon.title: KINETIC ARBITRAGEUR
build.playermarket.speed_demon.desc: Unmatched mobility, instant reflexes and terrain traversal.
build.playermarket.corporate_machine.des: Supreme institutional privileges, minimal broker commissions and peak cash flows.
build.playermarket.survivor.title: UNYIELDING JUGGERNAUT
build.playermarket.survivor.desc: Reinforced vital shielding, armored frame and immediate biological recovery.
build.playermarket.fragile_millionaire.d: Immense CR capital hoarded at the expense of nearly all human bodily traits.
